concerns.text: SC‑003 (measure total pipeline runtime against the 6‑hour CI limit) is not covered by any task. No task logs or asserts the overall execution time, nor is there a test that fails if the runtime exceeds the limit.

SC‑004 (measure PCA‑reduced dataset memory footprint against the 7 GB RAM limit) is not covered by any task. T005 implements PCA fitting but does not include a runtime‑memory measurement or a test that validates the RAM usage stays within the specified bound.
